name: v2 T=2 stagewise protocol (locked, v2.0)

pipeline.flags_note: stage2_update_mode=frozen, adv_norm_scope and continuation_action_mode take effect only in Phase B (after the freeze); Phase A trains stage 2 alone with all rows normalized and stochastic actions; continuation_value_mode=expected also takes effect only in Phase B: the stage-1 rows use the shock-integrated table value of the frozen stage-2 policy instead of the sampled continuation (requires frozen + mean + gamma = lambda = 1)

phase_A.lr: constant 0.0003 for local updates 1-1200, then linear 0.0003 -> 3e-05 over local 1201-1600

pipeline.freeze: frozen stage-2 snapshot = deep copy of the actor at the end of Phase A (B2 machinery; no grad, no optimizer)

phase_B.opponent: lagged copy of the actor, refreshed every 20 global updates

pipeline.lr_form: lr(j) = start + (end - start) * (j - local_first) / (local_last - local_first), applied to actor and critic before each update, constant within an update, Adam state preserved (run/run_final_dp_br_round3_dense.py:lr_at, kind 'linear'; run/run_v2_stagewise.py:Run.lr_for)
pipeline.evaluated_candidate: last iterate, Beta mean: stage 2 at the end of A (frozen), stage 1 at the end of B
unchanged: RNG streams and samplers (numpy PCG64 streams from SeedSequence([seed, q, namespace]))
on-path rule: open interval |d - drift| < 2q with exact cell masses
e~1 residual-band method on the final tier
outputs: manifest.json (commit, clean-tree flag, protocol SHA-256, q, seed)
gateA_{final,development}.npz, final_{final,development}.npz, drift_test.json, induced_band.json + sweep NPZ
gates.json (v1.1): G-A, G-F, G-N, run_pass, S1, v1_0_outcome, global_rng, protocol_version 1.1
gates.json (v2.0; replaces the v1.1 entry above): G-A, G-F, G-N, G-S, run_pass (v2.0), S1 (0.10), v1_1_outcome, v1_0_outcome, continuation_table, global_rng, protocol_version 2.0
manifest.json (v2.0; replaces the v1.1 entry above): continuation-table record (rule, build seconds, NPZ SHA-256)

continuation_table.applies_to: Phase B, stage-1 rows only: stage-1 return = r_1 + V2~(y), y = e_1 - e_1^opp (both efforts as executed, float64); stage-1 advantage = that return - V(s_1); stage-2 rows, their critic targets and every random draw are unchanged (shocks are still drawn); the opponent's stage-1 action stays sampled
continuation_table.definition: V2~(y) = E_z[g_2(y + z)], g_2(d) = w_l + DW F_xi(d + e_hat_2(d) - e_hat_2(-d)) - k e_hat_2(d)^2, e_hat_2 the frozen stage-2 Beta mean on the float path of continuation_action_mode=mean, z = eps_L - eps_O with density (2q - |z|)/(4 q^2) on [-2q, 2q]
continuation_table.built: once at Phase-B entry from the frozen stage-2 snapshot, by run/run_v2_stagewise.py:Run.run_phase calling utils.v2_continuation.build_continuation_table (step = run_v2_stagewise.CONT_TABLE_STEP, default rule); single-threaded, no RNG draw

rule.integration: composite Gauss-Legendre in z against the triangular density (2q - |z|)/(4 q^2) on [-2q, 2q]; weights include the density and sum to 1 to rounding
rule.panel_alignment: panels aligned at z = 0 and z = +-2q: each half interval is split into ceil(2q / panel_width) equal panels
rule.actor_evaluation: the frozen actor is evaluated directly at the quadrature nodes d = y + z; g is never interpolated

y_grid.range: symmetric on [-e_range, e_range] (e_range = e_max - e_min = 100), contains 0

rule.lookup: linear interpolation; refuses y outside the grid by more than edge_tolerance x max(1, grid span)
rule.numerical_constants_note: edge_tolerance and max_points_per_chunk are checked by the entry point against utils/v2_continuation.py; the 1e-9 inside the ceil() of the panel count and of the y-grid size is a literal of the module (pinned by its SHA-256); the chunk size only batches the actor evaluation (measured effect below 2e-15 DW, results/v2_refine/continuation_check.json key batch_noise_probe)

continuation_table.entry_point_refuses_other_values: the JSON rule must equal run/run_v2_T2_locked.py:LOCKED_TABLE_RULE, utils/v2_continuation.py defaults and run_v2_stagewise.CONT_TABLE_STEP must equal it (numerical parameters compared: panel_width, nodes_per_panel, y step, stage, dtype, edge_tolerance, max_points_per_chunk), and the table that is built is checked against it at the first Phase-B update
continuation_table.table_file: continuation_table.npz in the run directory: arrays y_grid and values (float64), written as an NPZ with fixed zip timestamps so that equal tables give equal file hashes
continuation_table.recorded_in: manifest.json (key continuation_table) and gates.json (key continuation_table): rule parameters of the table that was built, build seconds, SHA-256 of continuation_table.npz
continuation_table.rng: the build draws from no RNG: the five training streams, the torch generator and the three process-global RNGs are compared between Phase-B entry and the first Phase-B update; a moved training stream aborts the run, a moved global RNG is a global-RNG violation (exit code 5)

check_ii.parents: end-of-A states of the v1.1 rehearsal, seed 10501, both q (SHA-256 in the record)
check_ii.ii_a: halving the panel width and doubling the nodes per panel changes the table by <= 1e-8 DW
check_ii.ii_b: refined verifier (state step 0.25, 64 Gauss-Legendre nodes), both q: max over the effort grid of |V2~(e - e1_hat(0)) - (Q1(0, e) + k e^2)| <= 1e-6 DW
check_ii.ii_c: adding the convergence difference profile (finest rule minus default rule) to the table moves argmax_e [-k e^2 + V2~(e - e1_hat(0))] on a 0.001-effort grid by <= 1e-3 e1*

G-A.candidate: stage-2 last iterate (Beta mean of the live actor at global u1600)

all_must_hold.definition: eta_2 / DW = max over the full final-tier D_2 grid of the one-step deviation gap Delta_2(d), divided by DW (utils.dp_br_verifier.verify -> full_delta_max[2]; utils.v2_metrics.evaluate scalar 'eta_T_over_dw')

sqrt(mean over the recovery grid nodes with |d| < 2q of (e_hat_2(d) - e2*(d))^2) / e2*(0); recovery grid = symmetric grid on D_2 with step 'recovery_step' = 0.5 (utils.v2_metrics.recovery_metrics; independent of the verifier tier)
mean of e_hat_2(d) over the recovery grid nodes with |d| >= 2q, divided by e2*(0) (utils.v2_metrics.recovery_metrics; independent of the verifier tier)

G-F.candidate: full last iterate: live actor at t=1 (global u2200), frozen stage-2 snapshot at t=2

all_must_hold.definition: max over stages t and final-tier grid nodes d of G_t(d) = V_t^BR(d) - V_t^mean(d), divided by DW (utils.v2_metrics.evaluate scalar 'Gmax_full_over_dw')

gates.run_outcome: pass iff G-A, G-F, G-N and G-S all pass; a run failing G-A is a stage-2 failure: its Phase B is still executed and reported, and the run counts as failed; a run with a global-RNG violation (hardening) or any nonzero exit counts as failed; S1 at 0.10, the v1.1 outcome (G-A, G-F, G-N) and the v1.0 outcome are reported only
gates.dev_tier: G-A and G-F use the final tier; G-N compares development and final tier; every gate and reported metric is also reported on the development tier

G-N.stage: end of Phase A (eta_2) and end of Phase B (Gmax_full)

all_must_hold.definition: |eta_T_over_dw(development) - eta_T_over_dw(final)| of the G-A candidate at the end of Phase A
|Gmax_full_over_dw(development) - Gmax_full_over_dw(final)| of the G-F candidate at the end of Phase B

gates.comparison: every '<=' is inclusive; values compared at full float64 precision, no rounding

G-S.candidate: stage-1 last iterate: Beta mean of the live actor at t=1, d=0 (global u2200)

all_must_hold.definition: |e_hat_1(0) - e1*(0)| / e1*(0) (utils.v2_metrics.recovery_metrics 'stage1_rel_err_signed', absolute value); the v1.1 secondary criterion S1 with the threshold 0.05 (the 0929 target); e1* is the closed form and enters the evaluation only

stage2: smoothed_share_peak_gap_d0 (Pilot-1 method: 400 equal-probability nodes per Beta at d=0)
stage1_and_full: stage-1 decomposition: learning (e_hat_1 - e~1)/e1*, inherited (e~1 - e1*)/e1*, with residual bands
reported_not_gated.numerics: dev-tier minus final-tier difference of every gate and reported metric

peak_error: not gated; reported with its decomposition (smoothed-game share; Pilot 4 section 1d floor)

stage1_decomposition.method: e~1 = argmin_e Delta_1(e; e_hat_2) on the final tier, band = {e: Delta_1 <= min + floor}
stage1_decomposition.floor: max(Delta_1(e1*; e2*) on the final tier, 1e-12 DW)
stage1_decomposition.sweep_range: anchored at e1*, covering [min(0.4 e1*, e_hat_1 - 2), max(1.7 e1*, e_hat_1 + 2)]

confirmation.status: pre-registered; executed in the v2.0 round only if the re-rehearsal checks R1-R7 (results/v2_T2_locked/rehearsal_v2_0_checks.json) all pass
confirmation.seed_block_status: set by the PI (v2.0 round, D5); used for both q
confirmation.disjointness_check: tools/v2/seed_inventory.py before the block appeared in any JSON/CSV seed record: results/v2_T2_locked/v2_0/seed_inventory_pre_lock.csv (0 collisions among 305 recorded seed values); re-run at the lock commit with the files that declare the block excluded (--exclude): results/v2_T2_locked/v2_0/seed_inventory.csv; the stock scan at the lock commit finds only those declarations: results/v2_T2_locked/v2_0/seed_inventory_stock.out
confirmation.pass_rule: for each q, at least 18 of 20 runs pass (G-A and G-F and G-N and G-S); the confirmation passes iff both q pass; each q's pass rate is reported with an exact Clopper-Pearson 95% CI
confirmation.reporting: every run is reported, failures included; nothing changes after the lock
confirmation.crash_rule: infrastructure kill (OOM, disk full, process killed): move the run directory to confirmation_v2_0/crashed/q{q}/seed{s}_attempt1/ and re-run once into the original path; a second infrastructure failure stops the round and that run is not counted either way; any other nonzero exit (pipeline exception, global-RNG violation) counts as a failed run

safety_condition.normal_model: signed stage-1 error ~ N(mean, SD) fitted per q to that q's 10 rehearsal runs (SD with ddof = 1); a run passes G-S iff |error| <= the G-S threshold; G-A, G-F and G-N treated as passing; probability = P(Binomial(20, p_q) >= 18)

50.action_mapping: e = e_min + a (e_max - e_min); a ~ Beta(mu c, (1-mu) c)
50.mean_extraction: e_hat = e_min + (e_max - e_min) alpha/(alpha+beta) in float64 from float32 alpha,beta
50.action_sampling: numpy float64 Beta; clamp [1e-6,1-1e-6]; store float32; old/new log-prob on stored action

60.action_mapping: e = e_min + a (e_max - e_min); a ~ Beta(mu c, (1-mu) c)
60.mean_extraction: e_hat = e_min + (e_max - e_min) alpha/(alpha+beta) in float64 from float32 alpha,beta
60.action_sampling: numpy float64 Beta; clamp [1e-6,1-1e-6]; store float32; old/new log-prob on stored action
